name: Dictum Language Designer & Transpiler Architect
description: Extend and maintain the Dictum language itself. Add new syntax, backends, optimizations, and tooling. This is the ultimate skill — building the tool that builds everything else.
deliverables: New Dictum syntax feature (e.g., match expressions)
dictum_features: Classes for AST, Lexer, Parser, Emitter
example_snippet:
program DictumLexerStub:
    shape Token holds:
        Type as text
        Value as text
        Line as whole number
        Column as whole number
    end shape
    
    shape Lexer holds:
        Source as text
        Position as whole number
        Line as whole number
        
        method next_token produces Token:
            # Simplified tokenization
            keep T as Token with "EOF" and "" and Line and 0
            produce success with T
        end method
    end shape
    
    keep L as Lexer with "keep X as whole number" and 0 and 1
    keep T as Token
    call L.next_token giving T
    print the text "Token: " and T.Type and newline
end program
status_note: C++ backend active and CI-tested (C++17/20/23). dictum_file.c provides module system file I/O. Self-hosting requires multi-file imports (MISSING-08, pending).
